reasoning_traces.think:
The operators model market dynamics through probabilistic consensus, edge detection, and volatility adjustment. The consensus component score normalizes alignment percentage into a bounded score. Pricing edge evaluates deviation from fair value using implied probabilities. Volatility penalty adjusts reliability based on market liquidity and dispersion. These combine into a risk-weighted composite signal that informs pick confidence. Dualities emerge in how consensus and edge interact—high consensus may mask low edge, and vice versa. Failure modes include overconfidence in thin markets or misalignment between implied and actual outcomes. The system assumes rational bookmakers and stable market conditions, which may not hold during disruptions.
